steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Owoo... This is a trick... It's just a normal piece of candy... Owoo...
With the defeat of OwO the Archdemon, the villagers gained their freedom.
And thus, the fairy tale world restored its former tranquility.
Of course, we can't forget about the heroine who saved everyone.
Even though she didn't eat the candy of courage, everyone now says...
That once cowardly girl gained true courage.
